title: immense strain on popular tourist destinations
term: immense strain on popular tourist destinations
meaning_vi: áp lực to lớn lên các điểm du lịch nổi tiếng

examples.en: Overtourism has placed immense strain on popular tourist destinations, damaging fragile ecosystems and local infrastructure alike.

title: limited geographical boundaries
meaning_vi: ranh giới địa lý hạn chế

examples.en: Cities confined by limited geographical boundaries often struggle to expand their road networks fast enough to keep pace with population growth.

title: optimize the use of public infrastructure
term: optimize the use of public infrastructure
meaning_vi: tối ưu hóa việc sử dụng cơ sở hạ tầng công cộng

examples.en: Dense urban planning can optimize the use of public infrastructure, ensuring that bus and rail networks operate at full capacity.

title: reduce travel distances
meaning_vi: giảm khoảng cách di chuyển

examples.en: Building residential complexes near workplaces can significantly reduce travel distances for commuters.

title: digital infrastructure
meaning_vi: hạ tầng kỹ thuật số

examples.en: Investment in digital infrastructure allows commuters to track buses and trains in real time.

title: high-speed internet
meaning_vi: internet tốc độ cao

examples.en: High-speed internet on trains enables passengers to work productively during their journey.

title: smart-city service
meaning_vi: dịch vụ thành phố thông minh

examples.en: Real-time bus tracking is one of the most popular smart-city services introduced last year.

title: green innovation
meaning_vi: đổi mới sáng tạo xanh

examples.en: Government subsidies for green innovation have accelerated the development of affordable electric vehicles.

title: adopting smart ticketing systems
meaning_vi: áp dụng hệ thống vé thông minh

examples.en: By adopting smart ticketing systems, transport authorities can cut administrative costs and reduce fare evasion.

title: real-time traffic management
meaning_vi: quản lý giao thông theo thời gian thực

examples.en: Real-time traffic management systems adjust signal timings to reduce congestion during rush hour.

title: driving license
meaning_vi: bằng lái xe

examples.en: Applicants must pass both a written test and a practical exam before receiving a driving license.

title: traffic violation
meaning_vi: vi phạm giao thông

examples.en: Every traffic violation caught on camera is automatically recorded and linked to the driver's licence.

title: a drop in customer satisfaction levels
term: a drop in customer satisfaction levels
meaning_vi: sự sụt giảm mức độ hài lòng của khách hàng

examples.en: Delayed deliveries caused by road closures resulted in a drop in customer satisfaction levels for local businesses.

title: a more robust and efficient global market
term: a more robust and efficient global market
pronunciation: /ə mɔː rəʊˈbʌst ænd ɪˈfɪʃnt ˈgləʊbl ˈmɑːkɪt/
meaning_vi: một thị trường toàn cầu mạnh mẽ và hiệu quả hơn

examples.en: Investment in international shipping lanes has created a more robust and efficient global market for perishable goods.

title: acute food shortages
meaning_vi: tình trạng thiếu lương thực trầm trọng

examples.en: Disruptions to transportation networks during natural disasters can trigger acute food shortages in isolated regions.

title: as a means to balance accounts
term: as a means to balance accounts
meaning_vi: như một cách để cân đối thu chi

examples.en: Fare increases were introduced as a means to balance accounts after years of financial losses.

title: budgetary constraints
meaning_vi: những hạn chế về ngân sách

examples.en: Budgetary constraints have forced local councils to postpone several tram expansion projects.

title: economic cost pressures
meaning_vi: áp lực chi phí kinh tế

examples.en: Rising fuel prices have intensified economic cost pressures on bus companies nationwide.

title: economically viable
meaning_vi: khả thi về mặt kinh tế

examples.en: Building an extensive tram network is only economically viable in cities with sufficiently high population density.

title: enhanced operational efficiency
meaning_vi: hiệu quả vận hành được nâng cao

examples.en: The metro authority achieved enhanced operational efficiency by streamlining maintenance schedules and staff rosters.

title: escalating the price of fuel
meaning_vi: tăng giá nhiên liệu

examples.en: Escalating the price of fuel through taxation is a common government strategy to discourage unnecessary car use.

title: facilitates economic efficiency through specialization
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy hiệu quả kinh tế thông qua chuyên môn hóa

examples.en: Modern freight transport facilitates economic efficiency through specialization, allowing each region to focus on what it produces best.

title: grappling with
meaning_vi: vật lộn/đối mặt với (khó khăn)

examples.en: Many cities are grappling with the rising cost of maintaining ageing bus fleets.

title: have a comparative advantage
meaning_vi: có lợi thế so sánh

examples.en: Countries that have a comparative advantage in manufacturing rely heavily on efficient port and rail infrastructure to export goods competitively.

title: market stimulus
meaning_vi: động lực kích thích thị trường

examples.en: Tax incentives for electric vehicles act as a powerful market stimulus, encouraging manufacturers to accelerate green production.

title: remain solvent
meaning_vi: duy trì khả năng thanh toán, không bị phá sản

examples.en: Without government subsidies, several rural rail operators would struggle to remain solvent.

title: short-sighted behaviors
meaning_vi: những hành vi thiển cận

examples.en: Ignoring public transport funding in favour of new motorways reflects short-sighted behaviors by policymakers.

title: sustainable transport infrastructure
meaning_vi: cơ sở hạ tầng giao thông bền vững

examples.en: Governments must channel greater funding into sustainable transport infrastructure if they hope to meet long-term climate targets.

title: surplus
meaning_vi: lượng dư thừa

examples.en: A sudden surplus of young people without a driving licence would place extra strain on bus services.

title: visible enforcement
meaning_vi: sự thực thi pháp luật rõ ràng, dễ thấy

examples.en: Visible enforcement, such as patrol officers stationed near schools, discourages drivers from speeding.

title: contentious issue
meaning_vi: vấn đề gây tranh cãi

examples.en: Whether to prioritise roads or railways remains a contentious issue among policymakers.

title: diminishing public funding
meaning_vi: nguồn tài trợ công đang giảm dần

examples.en: Diminishing public funding for rail networks has left many rural communities with increasingly unreliable transport options.

title: do more harm than good
meaning_vi: lợi bất cập hại

examples.en: Banning cars entirely from the city centre without improving buses first might do more harm than good.

title: domestic supply
meaning_vi: nguồn cung trong nước

examples.en: Restricting imports would place excessive pressure on domestic supply, particularly for goods that rely on efficient transport networks.

title: holistic approach
meaning_vi: cách tiếp cận toàn diện

examples.en: Tackling congestion requires a holistic approach that combines infrastructure, pricing and public awareness.

title: mounting operational expenditures
meaning_vi: chi phí vận hành ngày càng tăng

examples.en: Public transport agencies are grappling with mounting operational expenditures, forcing many to raise fares or cut services.

title: underdevelopment
meaning_vi: tình trạng kém phát triển

examples.en: The underdevelopment of rural transport links continues to isolate remote communities from essential services.

title: volatile price instability
meaning_vi: sự bất ổn giá cả biến động thất thường

examples.en: Rising fuel costs have caused volatile price instability across the shipping industry, ultimately raising the price of imported goods.

title: harsher punishment
meaning_vi: hình phạt nghiêm khắc hơn

examples.en: Some lawmakers argue that harsher punishment for speeding would make drivers think twice before breaking the limit.

title: hazard perception
meaning_vi: nhận thức nguy hiểm

examples.en: New drivers are required to pass a hazard perception test before they can obtain a full licence.

title: legal deterrent
meaning_vi: biện pháp răn đe pháp lý

examples.en: Heavy fines act as a legal deterrent, discouraging motorists from using their phones while driving.

title: legal driving age
meaning_vi: độ tuổi hợp pháp được lái xe

examples.en: Some countries have raised the legal driving age in an attempt to reduce accidents caused by inexperienced drivers.

title: traffic regulations
meaning_vi: luật lệ giao thông

examples.en: Strict enforcement of traffic regulations has been shown to significantly reduce the number of road accidents in major cities.

title: address the concerns of businesses
meaning_vi: giải quyết các mối lo ngại của doanh nghiệp

examples.en: Before banning trucks from the centre, officials must address the concerns of businesses that rely on deliveries.

title: allocate national funding
meaning_vi: phân bổ ngân sách quốc gia

examples.en: The government plans to allocate national funding to double the length of the metro network.

title: directs financial resources to
meaning_vi: hướng nguồn lực tài chính vào

examples.en: The new transport policy directs financial resources to expanding suburban rail lines.

title: legislation
meaning_vi: luật pháp, đạo luật

examples.en: New legislation requiring seatbelts in all vehicles has significantly reduced road fatalities over the past decade.

title: robust public investment
meaning_vi: đầu tư công mạnh mẽ

examples.en: Robust public investment in light rail has transformed commuting patterns across the city.
